summary: A long, single-column (770px) specimen for Dunbar, a geometric sans revival of Erbar-Grotesk in three optical variants (Tall, Low, Text). It runs from a coral alphabet showing and a stack of retro posters, through fit-to-width editable pastry names labelled by style, a catalogue of OpenType features as grey-to-black before/after pairs, to a long illustrated research essay on Erbar, the designer's own account, footnotes and colophon.

instances.look: Fixed cyan bar across the top: 'DUNBAR' in dark blue, then Features, Research, Process and '↓ Buy' in white; it is painted into many crops of this capture as a cyan stripe

On cream, the full alphabet, figures and ampersand in thin coral Dunbar set as a justified five-line block (ABCDEFGHIJKL / MNOPQRSTUV / WXYZ0123456 / 789&abcdefghijkl / mnopqrsſztuvwxyz) signed 'DUNBAR by CJ Dunn' in bold coral
instances.learn: Open with the alphabet showing exactly as a metal-type foundry would: for a revival, the specimen page itself is the reference
